name: io.github.Jehad123-lab/dea
title: DEA
description: Decode any website with evidence: stack, design, motion, WebGL shaders, code and APIs.

environmentVariables.name: DEA_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Folder where DEA saves runs and evidence (default ~/.dea).

environmentVariables.name: DEA_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Policy mode for DEA's browser hands: restricted, supervised (default) or delegated. A tool call can never loosen it.
